description: Reduce depth to 6 and raise aspect ratio to 85 (model_dim 512, 4 heads) so the smaller model sees more tokens in 300s while keeping width.
Reduce Muon cautious weight decay from 0.2 to 0.1.
Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more training happens at peak LR.
Set HEAD_DIM to 64 so the 512-wide model uses 8 attention heads instead of 4.
Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**18 so grad accumulation drops to 2 and more optimizer steps fit in the 300s budget.
Add training-only label smoothing of 0.05 decaying linearly to 0 at half the time budget, passed as a tensor to avoid recompiles.
Multiply q by a fixed 1.2 after the existing post-rotary RMS norm to sharpen attention logits.
No change: the residual output projections are already zero-initialized.
Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.03 to add a brief LR warmup at the start of training.
Reduce EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4 to test whether the embedding Adam LR is too high.
Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine decay from 1 to FINAL_LR_FRAC over the last half of the time budget.
Use a lower Adam LR of 0.3 for the value embeddings, separate from the token embedding LR (the sigmoid gate already exists).
Replace the ReLU^2 MLP with a SwiGLU MLP (gate, up, down; hidden 1344 for dim 512, about matched params), with the down projection zero-initialized.
Set DEPTH=10 and ASPECT_RATIO=51 so the model is 10 layers deep at width 512 (4 heads).
Maintain an fp32 EMA (decay 0.999, foreach lerp) of all parameters starting after 10% of the time budget and copy it into the model right before the final evaluation.

issues: None blocking. The diff changes only the learning-rate schedule settings (WARMUP_RATIO 0.0->0.03, WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5->0.7, FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.0->0.1). It does not touch the val_bpb measurement, the data, the seed lines or the evaluation call.

z cannot be recomputed independently because the spread of the incumbent runs was not given. The reported z=-2.150 is consistent with (1.1145-1.1266)/s for s≈0.0056, which is plausible. The candidate is about 0.0121 bpb worse, so the reject decision is consistent.
Only one candidate run against 16 incumbent runs, but the gap is large enough that a replicate is not needed to justify rejecting.

description: Set WARMUP_RATIO=0.03, WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.7 and FINAL_LR_FRAC=0.1 so the LR ramps up briefly, holds a short plateau, then decays over a long warmdown to a 10% floor.
Lower SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 for the per-layer scalar Adam parameters.
Set DEPTH=6 with ASPECT_RATIO=85 (model_dim 512, 4 heads) and widen the MLP hidden layer from 4x to 6x model_dim.
No change: SwiGLU MLP was already tested in slot 11 (official 1.1179, +0.0034 vs incumbent) and rejected.
Shorten the Muon momentum ramp from 0.85 to 0.95 from 300 steps to 200 steps, then hold at 0.95.
Double UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008 to test whether the lm_head is under-trained in the 300s budget.
Use an all-short "SSSS" window pattern with the short window reduced to a quarter of the sequence length (last layer stays full context).
